patthana15.19:1.1: Hetuṃ atītārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu naatītārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana15.19:2.1: Hetuṃ anāgatārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu naanāgatārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana15.19:3.1: Hetuṃ paccuppannārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu napaccuppannārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
